# Answer me with HTML renderer

Upstream: https://github.com/QingYunA/answer-me-with-html
Pinned commit: `7acea24024923eaae8647f5988e826062456dc86` (CLI 0.5.5).
`am.mjs` is an unmodified upstream bundle, reused from the local how-this-works-lite vendor copy. MIT license: [LICENSE.txt](LICENSE.txt).
